messages:
Aria: FYI - NovaForge credit alarm fired overnight. We need a concise QBR addendum: 30d burn forecast, immediate mitigations, and an enablement checklist. Ben, can you run a quick projection? Clara, any rapid throttles or batching patches? Drew, prep a short customer-friendly ask (top-up vs throttle).

Ben: Running a 30d lookback -> forward now. Will give three lines: baseline, -15% quick wins, -30% optimized. Also converting tokens->credits->USD. ETA 20m.

Onboard-Bot: Alert at 5965432100: account=novaforge, credit_balance=950 (~9% remaining), avg_usage=760 credits/day, runway~1.25 weeks.

Clara: Pattern: lots of frequent small-embed calls from chat flows. Quick fixes: 1) temporary embeddings RPM cap (48h), 2) enable client-side batcher snippet, 3) prefix cache for repeated contexts. Throttle draft:
```
embeddings_throttle:
  max_rpm: 40
  duration: 48h
  rollback: on_errors>0.5% OR p99_latency>baseline*1.5
  resume_condition: 7d_avg<baseline*0.8
```
Will post alert rules and sample client batcher in 10m.

Drew: Draft ask: "We recommend reaching a 90-day runway. Options: (A) one-time 25% credit top-up, or (B) enable short-term throttles + 1-hr optimization session with our engineers, followed by a 14-day discretionary buffer if savings observed." I'll make one slide.

Aria: Action list: Ben (forecast CSV + chart) 20m, Clara (throttle + batcher snippets) 15m, Drew (1 slide ask) EOD. If Ben's projection <14 days Jordan/AE on-call to escalate for emergency uplift. I'll stitch the packet after attachments land. Thanks all :thumbsup:
